customer_message.subject: Underfloor heating – Ahornweg 118, Brugg
customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I rent a 2.5-room flat at Ahornweg 118 in Brugg from Stiftung Wohnen Zentral.

When I switched the underfloor heating on in early October, the living area simply stayed cold. The bedroom has a separate radiator which works, but the living area, where I spend most of the day, is at 17 degrees with the heating on full. I have reported it to the foundation by phone and email.

I suffer from arthritis, and the cold has made the pain in my hands and knees noticeably worse over the past weeks. My doctor has advised me to keep the flat warm, which I cannot do.

To be frank, I don't see why I should keep paying the foundation CHF 2550 for a flat I cannot heat. I have already found out where the rent deposit office for Brugg is, and the next rent is due on 1 November.

Please tell me what I need to do now and what documents you need from me.

Kind regards,
Priya Petrova
